job.title: Cook
job.description:
Ambassador Personnel is hiring a Cook in Savannah, GA. Pay is $19.00/hr, paid weekly.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and cook food following recipes and portion standards
  • Follow safe food handling, temperature and sanitation rules
  • Set up, clean and break down your station
  • Help the kitchen turn out large batches on schedule

Requirements

  • Able to stand for a full shift and lift up to 35 lbs
  • Able to follow recipes and food safety rules
  • Kitchen experience a plus
  • At least 6 months of related experience.
  • No diploma required.

Schedule

  • Sun-Thurs and Tues-Sat 1pm-9pm

Pay and benefits

  • Pay: $19.00/hr
  • Weekly pay

How to apply

Apply online or call (912) 330-7210.

Ambassador Personnel, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identity, or any other attribute protected by law.
